rationale: With only 12 minutes to close and price sitting at 96% of today's range near the session high ($13.71), the risk/reward for a long is poor — minimal upside before forced liquidation and meaningful downside if the high holds as resistance. A short against a strong uptrend (price well above VWAP at $13.45, 9-EMA at $13.64) in a high-relative-volume name with momentum is equally unattractive. The 5-minute ATR of ~$0.038 is too small relative to spread and slippage to construct a meaningful trade in the remaining time window.
